timeline.text: One of my boys stays at his grandmother's for weeks — no TV, no camera.
But the system judged him by home rules. Finishing tasks with no bonus read as 'done, unpaid' — shutting off his brothers' YouTube back home.
So a Supabase flag marks him off-site, and the home gate learns to skip him.
Away, he gets one task at a time, no cap, no bonus — for as long as he's gone.
His brothers' YouTube never drops again. Zero false shutdowns.
